_comment: Adding a method costs one entry. Point each target at a JSON file holding
{'y': [...], 'score': [...], 'D': [[...]]} -- labels, the method's score, and the
descriptor matrix, aligned by row. 'floor' is that method's own measured run-to-run
reproducibility; leave it 0.0 ONLY if you have measured it and it is zero, never because
it is unmeasured -- an unmeasured floor of 0 silently asserts perfect reproducibility.
MIN_TARGETS is 3: two targets give one transfer direction each way and no replication.

boltz2._floor_source: analysis/boltz2/FLOOR_RESULT.md -- MEASURED for Boltz-2 (24 duplicated-ligand pairs propagated through the 885-compound FXa panel, residual-AUROC 95% upper bound). Replaces 0.0201, which was the Vina scoring floor borrowed from analysis/pose_ensemble.
